description: This file defines the DirectoryCategory class, which models a category containing multiple DirectoryEntry objects, including properties such as name and an array of entries, with corresponding accessor methods.

classes.name: DirectoryCategory
classes.description: A class representing a category of directories, containing a name and an array of DirectoryEntry objects.

methods.name: DirectoryCategory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DirectoryCategory with a specified name and array of DirectoryEntry objects.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the directory category.

methods.name: getEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the directory category.

methods.name: getEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a DirectoryEntry at the specified index.
